requirement.name: Password authentication
requirement.text: The application SHALL create a session only after the supplied password matches the stored credential.

scenarios.name: Correct password
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user supplies the correct password
- **THEN** the application creates an authenticated session

scenarios.name: Incorrect password
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user supplies an incorrect password
- **THEN** the application rejects the login without creating a session
